verdicts.flaw_description: The measurement windows precede the intervention in three of the four runs: 'a titanium run ... switched 4 May, measured by 29 March', 'a brass run ... switched 5 October, measured by 30 September', and 'a steel run ... switched 26 November, measured by 2 November'. A cycle time measured before the coolant was switched cannot reflect the coolant. Secondarily, 'Every logged run was cut on a machine hired from outside, carrying its own tooling' makes the reassurance that 'Each shop kept its machines on the uncoated insert grade of the quarter before' irrelevant - the tooling actually used is left unspecified.

'Throughput at each site fell by half against the earlier quarter.' Halving the material processed is an obvious independent cause of lower particulate, and the offered insulation - 'Every stack logged here fired on a fixed duty cycle, the same hours whatever the throughput' - only fixes operating hours, not emissions per hour. It does not block the throughput-to-particulate pathway, so the 8-14 percent drops are confounded with a 50 percent throughput drop.

'Rates cover the patients whose whole stay ran under the protocol, and a quarter of each ward's patients had spells outside the protocol.' The outcome is computed on a per-protocol subset that excludes a quarter of patients, and patients with spells off the protocol are plausibly the sicker/longer-stay ones who drive infections, so the 6-11 percent drop can be produced by the exclusion alone. The confounder reassurance is also empty: 'Every ward here was cleaned by in-house staff, who took none of the contract work' makes the fact that 'Contract deep-cleaning hours ... matched the earlier quarter exactly' irrelevant, leaving in-house cleaning intensity uncontrolled.

'The central syllabus set coursework at a third of the final grade, up from a quarter, and every section was marked to that central syllabus.' The weight of coursework in the final grade rose between the comparison year and the measured year, and it applied to every section, so students had a stronger incentive to complete coursework regardless of the lab kit. This alone could produce the 6-11 point rise.

'Figures cover the orders rung up at the new prices, and about a fifth of each line's orders were rung up at the old prices.' The after-period average is taken on a selected fifth-excluded subset while the comparison month includes all orders, so dropping the old-price (plausibly discounted or lower-value) orders can by itself lift revenue per order by the 4-7 percent reported, with no pricing effect needed.

'Absence figures cover the pupils on the revised timetable throughout, and about a fifth of each cohort spent weeks on the old timetable.' Absence is measured only on the fully-compliant pupils while the prior-term baseline covers the whole cohort; the excluded fifth are precisely the pupils whose attendance was disrupted, so excluding them can produce the 4-7 percent fall on its own.
